body_markdown:
**WINCHESTER, Va., August 27, 2026** – Thirty years after inventing composite decking and creating an entirely new building products category,[Trex Company](https://www.trex.com/) \[NYSE: TREX\] is entering its next era of growth. As the company celebrates its 30th anniversary, Trex is expanding beyond its category-leading decking business with a vision to become the defining brand in outdoor living and double the size of its business over the next four years.


The company’s growth strategy centers on continued investment in manufacturing capacity, product innovation, strategic partnerships and digital solutions designed to make working with Trex a seamless experience for customers, contractors and consumers. Since 1996, Trex has broadened its portfolio beyond composite decking to offer a growing range of outdoor living solutions that help homeowners transform their backyards into complete destinations.


“Our founders challenged the status quo by developing a better alternative to wood,” said Adam Zambanini, President and Chief Executive Officer of Trex Company. “That entrepreneurial spirit remains at the heart of who we are today. Creating the composite decking category was just the beginning. Today, our opportunity extends far beyond the deck. We’re investing to lead the future of outdoor living with innovative, sustainable solutions that make it easier than ever for homeowners to create beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor spaces.”


**Building on Three Decades of Innovation**


Trex’s story began with an unexpected challenge: what to do with the growing volume of discarded plastic bags generated by a booming breadcrumb business. In the 1980s, entrepreneur and organic chemist Roger Wittenberg began experimenting with ways to transform the waste plastic film into something useful. After years of research and development, he discovered that combining the shredded film with reclaimed wood fiber created a durable material that could resist rot, splintering and insects – laying the foundation for a new category of outdoor building products.


That breakthrough innovation became the foundation for Trex Company, which was established in 1996 when Wittenberg and three other executives from Mobil’s Composite Products Division acquired the business. Over the past three decades, the company has grown from a single-product manufacturer into a global outdoor living company and the world’s leading brand of wood-alternative decking.


Today, Trex employs nearly 2,000 people, operates manufacturing facilities in Virginia, Nevada and Arkansas, and distributes products through more than 6,700 retail locations across six continents. Its portfolio extends beyond[decking](https://www.trex.com/products/decking/) and[railing](https://www.trex.com/products/railing/) to include[fencing](https://www.trex.com/products/fencing/) ,[deck drainage](https://www.trex.com/products/rainescape/) ,[lighting](https://www.trex.com/products/deck-lighting/) ,[pergolas](https://www.trex.com/products/pergola/) ,[outdoor kitchens](https://www.trex.com/products/outdoor-kitchens/) ,[furniture](https://www.trex.com/products/furniture/) ,[lattice](https://www.trex.com/products/lattice/) and other outdoor living accessories.


The same value-from-waste mindset that launched Trex continues to drive the company today. Trex composite decking is manufactured from 95% recycled and reclaimed materials, and to date, the company has upcycled more than 6.4 billion pounds of recycled polyethylene plastic film into durable outdoor products – helping divert waste from landfills and waterways.


**Positioned for the Next Era of Growth**


Demand for high-performance, low-maintenance outdoor living products continues to grow as homeowners increasingly view outdoor spaces as an extension of the home. Trex sees a significant opportunity to expand beyond individual products and deliver a broader portfolio of solutions for the entire backyard.


With a strong brand reputation, deep channel relationships, established manufacturing expertise and a track record of category innovation, Trex is positioned to capture this opportunity while continuing to deliver value for homeowners, contractors, retailers and distribution partners.


“We’ve spent 30 years earning the trust of homeowners, contractors and channel partners by consistently delivering innovation and performance,” said Zambanini. “Now we’re building on that foundation with a bold vision for the future. We believe the next era of growth will come from helping consumers think beyond a deck to an entire outdoor living experience, and Trex is uniquely positioned to lead that evolution.”


**Celebrating a Milestone**


To commemorate its 30th anniversary, Trex will host a series of employee celebrations and recognition events honoring the people, partnerships and culture of innovation that have shaped the company’s success. The celebration will culminate later this fall when members of the executive leadership team ring the Opening Bell at the New York Stock Exchange, marking both a significant milestone and the beginning of Trex’s next chapter.


“For three decades, we’ve challenged conventional thinking and redefined an industry,” added Zambanini. “As proud as we are of what we’ve accomplished, we’re even more excited about what comes next. Our vision is simple: to become the brand consumers think of first when they imagine their ideal backyard.”


For more information, visit[Trex.com](https://www.trex.com/) .

**About Trex Company, Inc.**


For more than 30 years, Trex Company \[NYSE: TREX\] has invented, reinvented and defined the wood-alternative decking category. Today, the company is the world’s #1 brand of premium, sustainable, wood-alternative decking and railing, and a leader in high-performance, low-maintenance outdoor living products. Boasting the industry’s strongest distribution network, Trex sells products through more than 6,700 retail outlets across six continents. Through strategic licensing agreements, the company offers a comprehensive outdoor living portfolio that includes deck drainage, flashing tapes, outdoor kitchen components, pergolas, spiral stairs, lattice, cornhole and outdoor furniture – all marketed under the Trex® brand.


Based in Winchester, Va., Trex is proud to have been named[America’s Most Trusted® Outdoor Decking](https://www.lifestoryresearch.com/2025-best-decking-ranking-review) ^ for the past 6 years (2021-2026) and included in[TIME’s list of “America’s Best Companies 2026](https://time.com/article/2026/07/09/americas-best-companies-2026/) , Newsweek’s list of the[Most Trustworthy Companies in America 2026](https://www.trex.com/our-company/press/trex-named-one-of-america-s-most-trustworthy-companies-by-newswe/) and USA Today’s 2026 list of “[America’s Climate Leaders](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2026/04/20/americas-climate-leaders-2026-list/89604420007/) .” The company has also been ranked on Barron’s list of the[100 Most Sustainable U.S. Companies](https://www.barrons.com/lists-rankings/top-sustainable-companies?page=1&) (2024 and 2025), was named one of[America’s Most Responsible Companies 2024](https://www.newsweek.com/rankings/americas-most-responsible-companies-2024) by Newsweek, highlighted as one of the[100 Best ESG Companies](https://www.investors.com/news/esg-stocks-list-of-100-best-esg-companies/) by Investor’s Business Daily, and named the[Sustainable Brand Leader](https://www.greenbuildermedia.com/blog/2025-sustainable-brand-index) in the decking category by Green Builder Media for 16 consecutive years. For more information, visit[Trex.com](https://www.trex.com/) .
